model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the performance gap, expressed as a percentage, across several unnamed categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled from left to right with values 15.15, 25.66, 28.29, 23.79, 21.88, 17.27, 22.41, 23.47, 24.01, 9.60, and 18.80, and is not sorted in any apparent order. The vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gap (%)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single, gray-blue bar with a numerical value displayed above it, varying in height from a minimum of 9.60 to a maximum of 28.29. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
